notes.title: GREED - Challenge 2 Update
notes.content: [h3]Additions:[/h3][list][*][p]Added new challenge level[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tool[/p][/*][*][p]Added partial controller support (currently only works in game and not in menus)[/p][/*][*][p]Level shortcuts (challenge levels now have entrances in different main levels, challenge levels can now be used to skip some main levels)[/p][/*][*][p]Best times shown on menu[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Updated graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked music[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed lag when crushing/exploding small enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera going through walls[/p][/*][/list][h3]Notice![/h3][p]In case the update has not automatically shown up in your downloads, you can access it by going to [b]Properties > Betas > Beta Participation and selecting v1.2.0.[/b][/p]

notes.title: GREED - Level 4 (2-1) Update
notes.content: [h3]Additions:[/h3][list][*][p]Added new level[/p][/*][*][p]Added new gun[/p][/*][*][p]Added "The Pillar"[/p][/*][*][p]Added ground slam[/p][/*][*][p]Added screen shake[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Menu ui reworked[/p][/*][/list][h3]Notice![/h3][p]I'm currently having some issues with the update on the Steam side of things, as this is my first Steam release. [b]Currently you can access the update by heading to Properties > Betas > Beta Participation and selecting v1.1.0. [/b]Sorry for the inconvenience.[/p][h3][/h3]
